name: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
summary: A full day in the hills west of the city, built around the Golden Bridge and the stone hands that hold it. The basic ticket includes the cable car. Skip it if the beach and Hoi An already have your days.
fee: 1,000,000 VND for a non-resident adult, including the cable car and the Golden Bridge. Under 1 m free.
getThere: By car from Da Nang. The drive is a hill trip, not a Grab across town. The exact minutes are check on arrival.
